questions.question_text: Which of these is considered a 'non-volatile' memory?
questions.explanation: ROM (Read-Only Memory) retains its data even when the power is turned off, making it non-volatile.

questions.question_text: What is the shortcut to copy text in most Windows applications?
questions.explanation: Ctrl + C is the standard keyboard shortcut to copy selected content.

questions.question_text: Which device is primarily used to input textual data into a computer?
questions.explanation: A keyboard is an input device designed to allow the user to type text and commands into the computer.

questions.question_text: Which storage device is generally considered the fastest for storing OS files?
questions.explanation: Solid State Drives (SSD) provide significantly faster data access and boot times compared to traditional hard disk drives.
